notes:
What's new in 0.1.65:
• New Home screen with a featured title, Continue Watching queue, and quick browse panels — plus three alternate layouts (Command Deck, High-Impact Theater, Studio Canvas) and an opt-in Layout Studio to rearrange it (Beta — not yet visually checked on a real screen, so please tell us if anything looks off).
• Two new appearance options: Aurora Spotlight and an opt-in Light theme.
• Cleaner window: Settings now uses your full window width, and the old File/Edit/View menu bar is hidden.
• Sidebar menu groups reorganized to be clearer.
• New security alerts: you'll be notified when a new device signs in or two-factor authentication is changed on your account.
• Fixed: Home screen getting stuck on 'Loading...' forever on a brand-new install.
• Fixed: Live TV looping 'Reconnecting...' forever instead of telling you the channel actually stopped.
• Fixed: fast-forwarding a video (especially away from home) could wrongly trigger an unnecessary 'unsupported format' re-conversion.
• Fixed: the web player could silently freeze during playback on a network hiccup; it now recovers automatically.
• Fixed: the Cast button now tells you honestly when casting can't work while watching away from home, instead of silently failing.
• Added confirmation prompts before several actions that used to happen instantly with one click (revoking a household member's device access, deleting an app password, clearing a queue, removing a station, and more).
• Continued accessibility improvements (better contrast and keyboard focus) across more settings screens.
• The Viewing Privacy page is now available in all 6 supported languages.
